# Doctor checks

`pinka doctor` runs these checks in this order. A check that does not apply to the host (no GPU, another node role or provider, no platform yet) is skipped, not passed. A failed check of severity `error` makes doctor exit with 2, a failed `warning` with 1 (see [Exit codes](exit-codes.md)).

| Check | Severity | What it asserts | Remediation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `install.record` | error | The install record is present, readable and only root can change it. | Run bootstrap: it writes a missing record (a legacy one on a host pinka provisioned before); never edit the record by hand. [How to fix install.record](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-install-record) |
| `preflight.outcome` | error | A fresh read-only preflight still allows the lab on this host. | Run `pinka preflight` and fix what it reports; see the support matrix. [How to fix preflight.outcome](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-preflight-outcome) |
| `preflight.drift` | warning | Outcome, provider and features match /etc/pinka/host-profile.json. | If the change is intended, run bootstrap with --refresh-profile. [How to fix preflight.drift](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-preflight-drift) |
| `services.units` | error | Every unit of pinka-lab.target is active. | `systemctl status UNIT` and `journalctl -u UNIT`; `pinka start`. [How to fix services.units](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-services-units) |
| `services.containers` | error | Lab containers run healthy with their pinned digests. | Run bootstrap again; it recreates containers from the pinned digests. [How to fix services.containers](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-services-containers) |
| `network.listeners` | error | Nothing listens outside loopback except sshd, expected host services and the listeners the host had before pinka. | Stop the listed service or bind it to 127.0.0.1. [How to fix network.listeners](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-network-listeners) |
| `network.install_path` | warning | The install's access path from outside the tailnet is closed. | Give consent to close it (firewall_close_install_path: true, or the Remote access screen), run bootstrap and, while it runs, log in as a researcher over the tailnet; the run closes the path at its end. [How to fix network.install_path](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-network-install_path) |
| `network.firewall` | error | The lab's firewall, its access guard and the Docker compatibility rules are present. | Run bootstrap with --tags firewall. [How to fix network.firewall](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-network-firewall) |
| `network.tailscale` | error | Tailscale is logged in with the expected name and tags; Funnel and Tailscale SSH off. | `tailscale up` per the Tailscale how-to (on an adopted node the owner restores the recorded name and tags); `tailscale funnel reset` removes Funnel, `tailscale set --ssh=false` Tailscale SSH. [How to fix network.tailscale](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-network-tailscale) |
| `network.tailscale_identity` | warning | An adopted Tailscale node carries the lab's tag and a key that does not expire. | Tag the node in the admin console or disable its key expiry; otherwise name it in the tailnet ACL another way and sign in again when the key expires. [How to fix network.tailscale_identity](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-network-tailscale_identity) |
| `gpu.docker` | error | A container of the pinned CUDA image sees the GPU. | Check the driver (`nvidia-smi`) and run bootstrap with --tags nvidia_container_toolkit. [How to fix gpu.docker](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-gpu-docker) |
| `gpu.cdi` | error | Docker gives containers the GPU through CDI. | Remove `"features": {"cdi": false}` from /etc/docker/daemon.json (on Docker older than 28.2 add `"features": {"cdi": true}`) and restart Docker; on a Docker pinka installed, run bootstrap with --tags docker. [How to fix gpu.cdi](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-gpu-cdi) |
| `gpu.driver_cuda` | error | The NVIDIA driver supports the CUDA version the pinned vLLM image is built on. | Install a driver branch that supports that CUDA version; on WSL2 update the NVIDIA driver on Windows (never a Linux driver inside WSL). [How to fix gpu.driver_cuda](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-gpu-driver_cuda) |
| `gpu.vllm` | error | vLLM answers /health when a deployment is active. | `journalctl -u pinka-inference.service`; reactivate the deployment. [How to fix gpu.vllm](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-gpu-vllm) |
| `gpu.arbiter` | error | The GPU arbiter's socket belongs to the controller (or the control endpoint); its mode and transition log are sound. | Run bootstrap with --tags gpu_arbiter; `journalctl -u 'pinka-gpu-*'` shows the arbiter. [How to fix gpu.arbiter](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-gpu-arbiter) |
| `training.containers` | error | A running training job's container has infra's fixed options and only its mounts. | Stop the run (`sudo pinka gpu idle`) and run bootstrap with --tags gpu_arbiter. [How to fix training.containers](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-training-containers) |
| `training.adapters` | error | Registered adapters are read-only and match their hash, MANIFEST.json and LINEAGE.json. | Remove the damaged adapter directory and train it again; never edit a registered one. [How to fix training.adapters](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-training-adapters) |
| `training.datasets` | error | Published datasets match their hash and list no instance of the test split. | Remove the dataset directory and publish it again from the platform. [How to fix training.datasets](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-training-datasets) |
| `training.caps` | warning | The active platform's training jobs stay within this host's training_caps. | Raise training_caps in host_vars (and run bootstrap with --tags gpu_arbiter,doctor), or deploy a release whose jobs ask for less. [How to fix training.caps](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-training-caps) |
| `training.availability` | warning | Whether this host trains: only a full node does. | Training needs a full node; split-node training is future work. [How to fix training.availability](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-training-availability) |
| `inference.isolation` | error | Only root, infra's scrapers and the platform's controller and inference broker reach the inference API on the loopback; only the controller the forwarder's control port. | Run bootstrap with --tags firewall,platform (`systemctl restart pinka-inference-guard.service` reloads it). [How to fix inference.isolation](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-inference-isolation) |
| `lab.window` | warning | Whether a maintenance window is recorded, and until when. | Production: `sudo pinka window close` once staging is done, then `sudo pinka start`. Staging: open a window on both sides or close the stale record. [How to fix lab.window](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-lab-window) |
| `docs.service` | warning | The docs service serves the installed documentation release. | Install the release (`sudo pinka docs install TARBALL --sha256 SUM`, or bootstrap with docs_release set), then `sudo systemctl start pinka-docs.service`. [How to fix docs.service](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-docs-service) |
| `inference.pairing` | error | Lab and inference nodes: certificate valid, private key root-only on a lab node, paired with the node the host_vars name. | Pair the nodes and set the peer in host_vars (pair-inference-node how-to). [How to fix inference.pairing](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-inference-pairing) |
| `inference.split_guard` | error | Lab and inference nodes: the split-inference ports on the tailnet admit only the paired peer's address, nobody before a pairing. | Pair the nodes again if the record has no address, then run bootstrap with --tags firewall (`systemctl restart pinka-split-guard.service` reloads it). [How to fix inference.split_guard](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-inference-split_guard) |
| `disk.free_space` | warning | Each mount point the lab uses has free space left, and its trend does not fill it soon. | Free space or lower the retention settings; `pinka preflight` shows the growth. [How to fix disk.free_space](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-disk-free_space) |
| `incus.pool` | warning | The storage pool has the chosen backend and enough free space. | Delete unused instances and images or grow the pool. [How to fix incus.pool](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-incus-pool) |
| `incus.objects` | error | The bench and build projects and the lab's profiles exist. | Run bootstrap with --tags incus. [How to fix incus.objects](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-incus-objects) |
| `incus.certificates` | error | Service client certificates exist, are owned by the service and trusted. | Run bootstrap with --tags incus, or rotate.yml --tags incus. [How to fix incus.certificates](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-incus-certificates) |
| `incus.metrics` | warning | Prometheus scrapes the Incus metrics endpoint. | Check the metrics certificate and the Prometheus target page. [How to fix incus.metrics](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-incus-metrics) |
| `incus.events` | warning | The Incus event feed into the journal runs. | `systemctl restart pinka-incus-events.service`. [How to fix incus.events](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-incus-events) |
| `layout.tree` | error | Lab directories have the layout's owners, modes and default ACLs. | Run bootstrap with --tags layout. [How to fix layout.tree](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-layout-tree) |
| `accounts.groups` | error | No researcher in docker or the Incus admin group; no service account in docker. | `gpasswd -d USER GROUP`, or list the admin in break_glass_docker. [How to fix accounts.groups](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-accounts-groups) |
| `deploy.provenance` | error | No .git in deployed paths; restricted packages only in the restricted area. | Remove the deployment and deploy again from the mirror. [How to fix deploy.provenance](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-deploy-provenance) |
| `platform.manifest` | error | The active release's manifest validates; active.json and its provenance record its hash. | Deploy the release again with bootstrap (--tags platform); never edit a deployed release. [How to fix platform.manifest](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-platform-manifest) |
| `systemd.hardening` | error | Platform units carry the hardening of their profiles; infra's hardened units theirs. | Run bootstrap with --tags platform. [How to fix systemd.hardening](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-systemd-hardening) |
| `sockets.permissions` | error | Platform sockets have the owners, modes and ACLs of their rendering. | Restart the owning service; run bootstrap with --tags platform. [How to fix sockets.permissions](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-sockets-permissions) |
| `sockets.agent_view` | error | The running agent sees no socket beyond its allowlist inside its mount namespace, and of the release only its own package and environment. | Run bootstrap with --tags platform; if a socket stays visible, report it as a bug. [How to fix sockets.agent_view](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-sockets-agent_view) |
| `sockets.acl_fallback` | warning | No platform socket fell back to mode 0666 for want of ACL support on /run. | Enable POSIX ACLs on the /run tmpfs (kernel CONFIG_TMPFS_POSIX_ACL), then restart the platform's sockets (`sudo pinka stop`, `sudo pinka start`). [How to fix sockets.acl_fallback](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-sockets-acl_fallback) |
| `telemetry.isolation` | error | Only infra's own clients reach the telemetry stores; the query socket's link, its directory and the query and agent sockets are right. | Run bootstrap with --tags firewall,observability. [How to fix telemetry.isolation](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-telemetry-isolation) |
| `postgres.roles` | error | Roles exist, reader and Grafana cannot use schema restricted, durability is on. | Run bootstrap with --tags postgres. [How to fix postgres.roles](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-postgres-roles) |
| `opa.authz` | error | OPA answers health and rejects policy and data writes (C6). | Run bootstrap with --tags opa. [How to fix opa.authz](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-opa-authz) |
| `telemetry.roundtrip` | error | A probe log, span and metric arrive in Loki, Tempo and Prometheus. | `journalctl -u pinka-observability.service`; check the collector's logs. [How to fix telemetry.roundtrip](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-telemetry-roundtrip) |
| `time.sync` | error | The clock is NTP-synchronized with a small offset. | Check timesyncd or chrony; on WSL run `wsl --shutdown` after resume. [How to fix time.sync](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-time-sync) |
| `backup.recent` | warning | Backups are configured, recent and the repository answers. | Configure the repository (backup how-to) or check `journalctl -u pinka-backup.service`. [How to fix backup.recent](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-backup-recent) |
| `backup.platform_state` | warning | Every platform state directory is listed in the manifest's backup.paths. | Add the directory to backup.paths in the platform's manifest and deploy the release, or accept that it is not backed up. [How to fix backup.platform_state](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-backup-platform_state) |
| `lab.health_gate` | error | The startup health gate passed. | `journalctl -u pinka-health-gate.service`; fix the failing check and `pinka start`. [How to fix lab.health_gate](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-lab-health_gate) |
| `lab.session` | warning | This boot's session record exists and is complete. | `systemctl restart pinka-session-start.service` after fixing the recorded errors. [How to fix lab.session](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-lab-session) |
| `lab.rolling_drift` | warning | On a rolling release, the system matches the session's fingerprint. | Use `pinka update-host` for updates; reports show the fingerprint diff. [How to fix lab.rolling_drift](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-lab-rolling_drift) |
| `resources.cpusets` | warning | Lab services run on cpuset_services, both CPU sets exist on this host, and no core's SMT siblings are split between them. | Set cpuset_services and cpuset_targets in host_vars to CPUs the host has (on WSL: processors= in .wslconfig) and run bootstrap; then restart the lab (`sudo pinka stop`, `sudo pinka start`) so services move to their CPUs. [How to fix resources.cpusets](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-resources-cpusets) |
| `wsl.config` | warning | WSL: wsl.conf, memory, CPUs and /dev/kvm as expected. | Copy the recommended .wslconfig on Windows and run `wsl --shutdown`. [How to fix wsl.config](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-wsl-config) |

## Smoke checks

`pinka doctor --smoke` adds one check `smoke.<blueprint>` (severity `error`) per golden image blueprint of the lab description. It launches a throwaway target of the newest image in the project `bench` on a fresh run network without NAT, with the run ACL and the telemetry proxy device, and asserts that systemd is running, the blueprint's services are active, a log line tagged with the throwaway run ID reaches Loki, the internet is unreachable, and the lab host does not answer on the lab's ports. The target and its network are deleted afterwards, also on failure. VM blueprints are skipped. See [How to fix a failed doctor check](../how-to/fix-doctor-checks.md#check-smoke) when one fails.
